request.description: Edit ONLY the wing pose of this exact white and icy-blue phoenix. BOTH wings are at the SAME phase of a bird wingbeat, simultaneously raised HIGH in a clear upright V above the shoulders, both wing tips ABOVE its head and body. The near wing and far wing have matching shoulder/elbow angles and equal upstroke timing. Do NOT put one wing up and the other wing down. Keep the body level and facing right, exact head, beak, cyan/white feather colors, crest, long flowing tail and the same life stage. Two complete visible feathered wings attached at the shoulders, physically plausible anatomy, no loop-shaped wings. Transparent background, no snow, rings, energy, trails, background, saddle or rider. Entire bird including both raised wings fits inside the canvas with padding.
